notes:
Consolidation only; no web calls were made in this step (the session search budget was reported exhausted by every lens, and no candidate pair needed the web to decide sameness). No files written. 27 entries (one above the 16-26 target) because the services lens and the flagged practices each needed their own bounded files; if the owner wants 26, merge combos-rfq-market-making into perps-lp-rewards-basis as 'new 2026 maker surfaces' (not recommended: different builds).

SEED MAPPING CAVEAT: the owner's 11 seed categories were not included verbatim in the task text and are not in the repo (checked docs/prediction-market-research/ and plans/). seed_category values are my inference from the task description (liquidity provision/market making, same-platform arbitrage, cross-platform arbitrage, resolution sniping, copy trading, staking, anti-Sybil/airdrop farming, information edge, directional/forecasting, incentive farming, services/data, insider/manipulation). The orchestrator should re-map against the real list; every inferred seed has at least one entry, and market making and same-platform arbitrage are split as the brief requested.

MERGE DECISIONS WORTH KNOWING: (1) Experimental-rated candidates were kept only as sub-variants when they are the same mechanism as an Established/Emerging entry (sponsored-pool sniping, UMA disputing, perps basis, intl-vs-US book gap, liquidity-crunch trades, holding rewards, academic LLM adjudicator, narrative manipulation, builder self-volume, airdrop positioning); standalone Experimental/theoretical ideas went to 'dropped' for the speculative band, with suggested groupings there (quoting models; in-play maker/fade ideas; LLM forecasting + sizing layer; recalibration; lead-lag; public-baseline models). (2) Macro nowcasting and the forecast-to-bet sizing layer were rated Emerging by their lens but have no Polymarket practitioner evidence, so they are routed to the speculative band. (3) MNPI insider trading and informed-flow following share one flagged file because they rest on the same evidence base; the scope requires the illegal and grey parts to be kept visibly separate. (4) Matching-delay / last-look candidates were folded into event-market-making-spread-carry and cross-referenced from the crypto and sports maker files rather than given their own file. (5) 'category' for the two pure-exploit entries is labelled 'Insider / manipulation-adjacent (flagged)' instead of the lenses' Arbitrage/Directional labels, which were misleading.

EVIDENCE CAVEATS FOR FILE AUTHORS: all URLs are copied from the lens inputs; several are headline/snippet-only or abstract-only as marked by the lenses (CNN teleprompter, SSRN DOIs, Bloomberg Law, Newser/Bloomberg), and pullpush.io URLs are Reddit mirrors.
